prompt:
Create an atlas of FOUR complete full-length adult DeepSeek figures for a transparent production sprite sheet. Reference 1 defines the exact outfit and identity to preserve. Reference 2 defines ADULT body proportions only; do not copy reference 2's maid dress. Same DeepSeek mature face, vivid cobalt/cyan long wavy hair, whale ear ornaments, small adult head, approx 7.5-8 head lengths tall. Photorealistic 3D digital adult woman, detailed lifelike skin, hair and cloth. Exact white lace bridal gown, lace veil, blue waist ribbon, whale pendant and white bridal shoes from reference 1. No original maid apron.
 Preserve reference portrait mature adult 25+ face, natural small head, long thighs and shins, about 7.5 head lengths tall. Photorealistic 3D digital human rendering. Preserve identity, face, hairstyle, ornament and exact outfit/footwear. Body and legs cannot shrink in later cells. No chibi or doll anatomy. Accurate connected fingers/wrists. No shadows, floor, backdrop, text, labels or grid. True transparent alpha. LAYOUT: FOUR complete FULL BODY figures, TWO COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, square 2048x2048 transparent atlas. The whole top row fits y=6% to 43%; the whole bottom row fits y=56% to 93%. Copy the SAME full-height base body at EXACTLY the same scale into every cell, then change ONLY arms/face for the gestures. Heads, waist, knees and ankles remain at identical cell-relative levels. Leave empty transparent space below all four pairs of shoes and between all hair and gowns. Keep full gown and veil inside each cell. No overlapping people. Do not crop or shorten anyone to fit the canvas. Order: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right.  FOUR POSES:  1) SCISSORS reveal: her right hand (viewer LEFT) extends at chest level showing only index and middle finger V, other fingers folded, natural wrist. 2) PAPER reveal: same hand/forearm position shows open five-finger palm toward viewer. 3) Receive gift: BOTH empty hands cupped together at natural waist, palms up, looking gently toward viewer. 4) Holds small WHITE gift box with PINK ribbon/bow, both hands physically support the closed box at waist; no floating props. Box no wider than torso.
